name: plain_page_no_long_run_no_false_alarm
spec_quote: detect_ats(text) scans a page's HTML + URL for links to applicant-tracking systems and returns [[system, ident], ...] in a fixed preference order, each once. Examples of what it recognises (unchanged): ... "https://jobs.lever.co/acme" → ["lever", "acme"].
